semiconductor_relevance: High — Yamaha Robotics Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor back-end manufacturing equipment and electronic component assembly, making it a key player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Yamaha Robotics Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of semiconductor back-end manufacturing equipment and electronic component assembly equipment. The company operates under the brands Shinkawa, Apic Yamada, and PFA, providing comprehensive solutions for semiconductor packaging and assembly processes.
capabilities: Die Sorter and Pick & Place systems

regional_presence.Japan: Yamaha Robotics is part of the Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd. group and leverages Japan's manufacturing capabilities.
